proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5228 jihvā expressly lists Gawri zip, Ku. jibṛo and Nepali jib(h)ro tongue. These support the zīp and jibra variants; yīv and jiũ require local consonant evidence. Reviewed comparator: Majhi jibro “tongue” (f_4bpw36n72gjcw). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.
